Hell Fracture Warlock Endgame Guide for Diablo IV Season 15 - Hell's Legacy

by MacroBioBoi
Season 15 - Hell's LegacyLast Updated: September 22, 2026
Endgame

Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Introduction

Hell Fracture is an amazing tool for stacking single target as well as AoE damage! This makes it a terrific build for Killing Bosses and clearing speedfarm content, all from the comfort of a screen's distance away. With an easily accessible list of scalers for Abyss Shadow Damage as well as Overpower and Hex Damage, the build just gets stronger and stronger with every Paragon Point and gear upgrade you find along the way.


Transform into Demonform with Metamorphosis for added tankiness. Nether Step adds even more mobility for speedfarming, or complete Immunity with its second variant to ignore difficult boss mechanics. This is especially useful for getting your first Uber Mephisto kill!


The build can basically pilot itself, or you can take full control and wring every bit of value out of its skill rotation!

Switch currently displayed active set

Equipment

Here you learn how to optimize your Hell Fracture Endgame Warlock with the correct Legendary and Unique items, Talisman and Charm options, Item Stat Priorities, Runes, and Class Mechanic choices.

Gear:

  • Stealth is made by putting Tal + Eth with a White Armor in the Horadric Cube.
  • Ancient's Pledge is made by putting Ral + Ort + Tal with a White Focus in the Horadric Cube.
  • Prid rune triggers Dark Prison automatically as if you cast it.
  • Aspect of Accursed Touch applies Vulnerable.
  • Since you apply four Hex stacks to enemies, Aspect of Calamity is effectively 80% Critical Strike Chance. Make sure to not overcap with unnecessary rolls on your gear.

Charms:

  • Any Set Charm bonuses are good to have but Fer of Slaughter offers the best of survivability and damage.

Important Stats

  • ~50% Attack Speed.
  • 20% Critical Strike Chance.
  • Maximum Life Rolls on nearly every gear piece.
  • 1x Temper of "Lucky Hit Restore Resource".

Gear:

  • Night Terror needs you to maintain Shadowform stacks as well as Stealth. You can regain Stealth once per second by walking forward with active Shadowform stacks. OR from the continuous effect of Metamorphosis: Terror Demon.
    • If you're unlucky and find a The Hemat Stone + Night Terror charm, you can swap these until you have the optimal combination.
  • Tidal Aspect/Aspect of Deeper Shadows both need to be on the build. With the former on Boots and the latter transfigured onto your amulet, ideally. You can mix and match these if you get unlucky on your transfigure outcomes.
  • Vulnerable is applied by the Season 15 Splinter: Abyssal Splinter of the Mother. Prior to this you can imprint Aspect of Accursed Touch instead of Aspect of Heresy.
  • Early on swapping Aspect of Heresy for Aspect of Calamity can help to cap your Critical Strike Chance.

Charms:

  • Phoba of Harash's Shadow offers the most damage scaling as well as premium CC via the Dominate effect. It also automates Sigil of Subversion trail generation, which help to maintain your Shadowform stacks.
    • The Hemat Stone is required for the build to function. Prioritize crafting this as soon as possible if you cannot loot one organically.
  • Good alternative stats on your Charms include +x to Abyss/Occult Ranks, Maximum Life and All Stats.

Seasonal Shards:

  • In your Leoric's Crown put:
    • Abyssal Splinter of Pain great survivability tool which comes at the cost of movement speed. Abyssal Splinter of the Mother grants Unhindered which negates this effect.
    • Abyssal Splinter of Anguish offers a large amount of Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance to reach the 100% caps.
    • Can make resource management impossible prior to finding a Ring of Starless Skies. Swap to Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire as an easy scaler.
  • Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone scales your damage as you kill enemies.
  • Abyssal Splinter of Damnation increases your XP gain.

Important Stats

  • >70% Attack Speed
  • ~100% Critical Strike Chance
  • 1x Temper of "Lucky Hit Restore Resource".
  • +15 Ranks to Abyss Skills (To get Metamorphosis to Skill Rank 30 for 24 second Duration)

  • Night Terror
  • Spine of Tathamet
  • Crown of Lucion
  • The Hemat Stone (Charm)
  • The Eightfold Idol

Skills

Learn more about the Skill Tree and Gameplay Rotation for the Hell Fracture Endgame Warlock here.

Skill Rotation:

  • While Speedfarming, you can basically just cast Hell Fracture and hit the other buttons if you're so inclined.
  • Cast Metamorphosis once and do not click this button again. Recast if it drops off.
  • Cast Command Fallen three times to summon all three little guys. Recast as needed.
  • Command Valloch to start and whenever the timer runs out.
  • Cast Sigil of Subversion on top of the pack of enemies.
    • If you trigger the trails and they move in the direction of the next pack, make sure to run along them for Movement Speed.
  • Now spam Hell Fracture! Remember it leaves behind Fractures that continue to pop. For optimal speed, learn how many pops are needed to kill a pack of enemies and move on to begin casting on the next pack, so the remaining Fractures kill those now behind you.
  • Use Nether Step when moving between packs, teleporting past walls and maintaining Movement Speed bonuses.
    • Against Bosses, swap to Gloomwalker to gain Immunity and dodge deadly mechanics.

Skill Rotation:

  • Command Valloch to start and whenever the timer runs out.
  • Cast Nether Step to gain your initial Shadowform stacks. Quickly step in between every few casts tomake a new Sigil of Subversion trail.
    • While using Abyssal Splinter of the Mother for Vulnerable, make sure to collide with the pack of enemies to apply Dominate and Vulnerable.
  • Cast Metamorphosis whenever you're engaging a pack of enemies, this maintains 100% uptime on Stealth for maximum damage. Damage will drop a bit when Metamorphosis ends. Instead move in between each cast to regain Stealth until the cooldown is up.
  • Cast Dark Prison whenever you're engaging a pack of enemies and when it comes off cooldown.
  • Cast Sigil of Chaos whenever it comes off of cooldown.
  • Now spam Hell Fracture! Remember it leaves behind Fractures that continue to pop. For optimal speed, learn how many pops are needed to kill a pack of enemies and move on to begin casting on the next pack, so the remaining Fractures kill those now behind you.
  • Use Nether Step when moving between packs, teleporting past walls and maintaining Movement Speed bonuses.
    • Against Bosses, swap to Gloomwalker to gain Immunity and dodge deadly mechanics.

Paragon

Progress your Hell Fracture Endgame Warlock through the Pit to rank up your Glyphs. Carefully check your Paragon Boards to ensure correct order and rotation.

Level in Order:

  • Empowered
  • Destruction
  • Abyssal

Mercenary

Mercenaries are unlocked during the Vessel of Hatred campaign and assist you in battle. You can have one hired (permanent) mercenary during solo play and a reinforcement who assists you from time to time in certain situations. Here are our recommendations for the Hell Fracture Endgame Warlock.

  • Varyana can be used to increase your Healing rate in battle with Taste of Flesh or build down to Bloodlust if you're easily managing survivability.
  • Raheir's Bastion is a super safe and reliable way of surviving dangerous boss mechanics.
  • Raheir and Aldkin offers the most survivability you can get from your mercenaries. Raheir also offers an amount of damage scaling vs enemies he's Taunted.
  • Raheir and Aldkin offers the most survivability you can get from your mercenaries. Raheir also offers an amount of damage scaling vs enemies he's Taunted.

FAQ & Mechanics

Take a look at this section for a deeper dive on Frequently Asked Questions, common mistakes and the underlying mechanics of how the Hell Fracture Endgame Warlock works.

    • The Soul Shard combination of Ritualist Shard + Abyssal Fragment does many things to empower the build.
      • Shard first grants a multiplier for each Overpower stack you have, and increases Skill size as well. When you have 4 stacks of Overpower (or more), Hell Fracture applies 2 Hex stacks to the target.
      • Fragment makes it so that Hex stacks 4 times instead of 3, and at 4 stacks begins a 4 second counter, where 25% (50% with the Unique Amulet) of all damage dealt to the target applies again. You also stack Hex more quickly when you use Command Valloch
    • Command Valloch passively increases your Overpower stacks limit and increases your Maximum Wrath. On command, they fill your Overpower stacks and grant Wrath Regeneration.
    • Having Overpower stacks grants Additive damage from the stat "Damage per Overpower Stack", making this scale significantly higher than other additive damage options in the same slot.

Summary

Hell Fracture is a multifaceted and high input high output build on the Warlock. Maximizing you Overpower synergies, Occult Skills and Shadowform + Stealth allows for entertaining gameplay and big damage output!

  • Night Terror requires you to have Shadowform stacks and maintain the Stealth buff. Use Metamorphosis: Terror Demon for both, add on Aspect of Deeper Shadows to reach 15 total stacks and then rip apart enemies while standing on Sigil of Subversion trails to max out your bonuses from Phoba of Harash's Shadow.
  • Being an Occult Skill, Hell Fracture benefits from the Ritual Shard and Abyssal Fragment with Command Valloch as a massive Wrath battery and Overpower stacks provider.
  • Occult utility skills are second to none! Nether Step is great for speedfarming as well as fighting difficult bosses, while Dark Prison offers more defensive layers than any other skill in the game.

I hope you love your time with the screenpopping, showstopping and hilariously over the top Hell Fracture Warlock! In Bocca al Lupo!

Changelog

  • Updated for Season 15 Start.

    • Updated early game runeword inclusion, swapped to Leorics Crown as a baseline and added a speedfarm variant including Enigma. 09/17/2026
    • After testing Eightfold Idol, Stone of Jordan performed better and had higher average damage output. 09/21/2026
    • Swapped the build to Twisted Fragment, which requires Sigil of Chaos on the bar, a slight change to the skill rotation and swapping Duelist for Ignition aspect. Everything else on the build runs the same. 09/22/2026
